question: How can the verified S1 mouse and author-summary endpoints be presented legibly on separate axes in the owner-specified figure style?
decision: Replace the displayed S1 figure with a versioned black-text rendering and stop after its review checkpoint.
strongest_rival: Color-coded text, inadequate contrast or confusing scales could imply comparable assays or obscure sample size.
discriminator: Inspect the PNG and PDF, verify all PDF text is black and within the page and uses a single font family, and bind each plotted endpoint to a frozen S1 table.
exposure_record: The numerical S1 receipt completed and the previous figure was inspected before this display amendment. All outcomes remain exposed.
biological_unit: Separate mice in the FOS panel; cells are counted inside each mouse. For Tables 1 and 3, the authors summarized mouse-by-state data; this readback uses gene-by-stage and state-by-stage statistics, not original replicate observations.
nesting_and_overlap: Replicate labels repeat across independent harvest stages. Fig. 1k is part of Fig. 1l; the controls are reused. Protein and sequencing have no documented animal or cell identity crosswalk. RNA genes and three epithelial states are not independent mice.
population_and_selection: All 19 MOESM7 mouse-labelled rows; primary early recovery day 63 and control day 0 (three per group). All nine Fos-leader rows from Table 3, and all uniquely keyed stem-cell genes in the acute, chronic and recovered sheets of Table 1 as identified in Supplementary Information p.10. The extra 50-day RNA sheet lies outside the original 1d-f three-stage comparison.
contrast: Retain the frozen unpaired contrast and stage summaries in original units; no new analysis.
endpoint: Versioned grayscale PNG and PDF, plus PDF text style and page-bound checks.
methods: Read exactly four prior S1 source tables. Draw all 19 mice, counts and days; plot original nine Fos motif deltas and fixed-union RNA up counts with explicit mouse n, axes and missingness. Use DejaVu Sans, pure black text and directly labeled grayscale marks, with new filenames. Inspect both rendered exports.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep the previous S1 report of unavailable RNA values and original held assays; no addition, exclusion or imputation.
multiplicity: One prespecified descriptive protein contrast; no new tests. Original BH-adjusted motif values and DESeq2 adjusted P values are copied, not recalculated. Stage/state and RNA summaries are exposed context.
precision_basis: Three independent mice per primary group and two to four per other stage. Display every observation, stage range and deletion sensitivity. No population confidence claim, cell-level interval or repeated-measures inference.
interpretation_limit: A staining fraction, state-mean motif accessibility delta and RNA detection count measure different features in separately sampled material. The readback cannot establish elevated accessibility in the stained cells, transcriptional equivalence, clonal inheritance, tumour growth or persistent chromatin in individual tissue cells.
stop_rule: Stop on changed input or code hash, render failure, nonblack/nonconforming/clipped PDF text or unexpected bounds. Retain prior versions.
amendment_reason: Owner requested black figure text, a consistent conventional font, grayscale-identifiable groups, visible biological n and final-size inspection. Numerical S1 products remain frozen.
